part.text: {"items":[{"index":1,"kind":"copies","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"Run many independent chains simultaneously on one or more GPUs, each chain on its own device or thread","reason":"Independent chains are the same computation run side by side; each chain stays strictly sequential, removing no step dependency."},{"index":2,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"compute batched likelihoods for many parameter vectors concurrently on the GPU, vectorizing surrogate evaluation across parameters and time windows","reason":"Surrogate changes what is computed, enabling batched GPU likelihoods; the chain still waits on each likelihood, and batching is across parameter vectors."},{"index":3,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"propagate, reweight, and resample particles level by level, parallelizing the per-particle likelihood and proposal work","reason":"SMC changes the sampler, but tempering levels remain sequential; per-particle work is independent items evaluated side by side."},{"index":4,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"yes","quote":"where possible, use associative scans or linearized operators to parallelize the time recurrence","reason":"Associative scans reassociate the recurrence so time steps are computed simultaneously, removing the step-after-step dependency."},{"index":5,"kind":"copies","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"Parallelize independent catchment-level MCMC samplers over many GPUs or workers","reason":"Independent catchment samplers run side by side; each chain remains sequential, and async aggregation avoids waiting rather than parallelizing steps."}]}
